posts.title: Graceful Shutdown Starts by Refusing New Work
posts.summary: Graceful shutdown is an admission-control protocol, not just a signal handler. Stop accepting new requests or leases before draining active work, and budget for routing lag, long-lived connections, and the hard termination deadline.

posts.title: A Sandbox With Open Egress Is an Export Path
posts.summary: Treat outbound network access as a separate, explicit capability. Start an agent sandbox with no egress, then grant only the named destinations and operations a task requires through a broker that can enforce and audit them.
